title: Wayback Machine — see how a site looked in the past
$comment: Built from the official help page https://help.archive.org/help/using-the-wayback-machine/ , which documents the flow: (1) enter a URL, (2) browse its history, (3) pick a date from the calendar. This screenplay performs those documented steps against the LIVE system, so `nolan verify` answers 'do the help doc's steps still match the product?'. The scene change uses the help page's own documented `*/url` shortcut to reach the calendar.

beats.text: The Wayback Machine keeps snapshots of the web.
